sections.title: Pay in any currency
sections.description: Tap the currency symbol on the amount to record a purchase in another currency. Spenzy converts it to your wallet's currency, and you can enter the exact amount your bank charged.

sections.title: Foreign receipts just work
sections.description: Scanned and shared receipts in another currency are now converted instead of rejected.

sections.title: Manage friends and categories
items: Edit or remove saved Split Bill friends, several at once.
Expense, Income and Transfer categories now share one list.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Scanning receipts and adding by text are working again. Sorry for the interruption, and thanks for your patience!
More accurate totals for wallets in other currencies.
Changing your main currency now updates everything right away.
Wallet expense reports (PDF) now always include all your transactions and the correct total.
